title: ericameria palmeri var. pachylepis
intro: Ericameria palmeri var. pachylepis, commonly known as Palmer's goldenrod, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is a shrub or subshrub with yellow flowers and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits. Palmer's goldenrod is believed to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Palmer's goldenrod include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
